title.narrative: Access Support Unit in the State of Palestine

description.narrative:
To ameliorate the delivery of humanitarian assistance and advance the protection of civilians, and the movement of people, the access mechanisms in the State of Palestine, this project will bring together and harmonize the Access Coordination Unit (ACU), and the Project Management Unit (PMU) into a single Access Support Unit (ASU) comprising two core elements or pillars:
- Access of People
- Access of Goods and materials
Under the overall leadership and guidance of the Deputy Special Coordinator/Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator (DSC/RCHC)) with substantive and coordination support from OCHA and UN Special Coordinator’s Officer (UNSCO) and the Resident Coordinator's Office (RCO), the core functions of the Access Support Unit will be to: 
- Support to movement of humanitarian personnel
- Management of Emergency Coordination Portal
- Facilitation and monitor the movement of dual use goods, materials and equipment into Gaza, in support of reconstruction, development, humanitarian, and large infrastructure projects as well as the private sector
- Support to Policy Development and Advocacy
